text: A simple illustration of a dynamic digital image of a huge restaurant hall. Shooting at a high angle. Close-up: a dead 30-year-old Serb of ordinary build, with raven-colored hair cut into a crew cut, sits on a semicircular leather sofa with his eyes closed, leaning his head back against the high back of the sofa.  The handle of the knife protrudes from his chest strictly perpendicular to his body, the blade is deeply and firmly embedded in his chest under his shirt and the blade is not visible. The place where the knife entered the body is heavily bloody. He has an elongated aristocratic face with a well-defined chin, deep-set eyes and an open mouth. He's wearing a white shirt with the collar open. In front of him is a table with an open bottle of vodka and a shot glass. Background: dusk, far behind in the semi-darkness you can see the wall of an ornate restaurant, in the hall there are exactly the same semicircular sofas and completely empty unoccupied tables in front of them. The atmosphere is harsh, gloomy, noir-style, with voluminous picturesque concept art with rich textures. Futuristic, high-quality detail, professional shooting, depth of field, detailed natural skin texture.
